description: Source code for parsing line ranges and function names in a diff or code context, including functions for parsing location specifications and regex-based function name matching.

methods.name: parse_loc
methods.description: Parses a location specification string, handling relative offsets, line numbers, and regex patterns to determine line positions.

methods.name: match_funcname
methods.description: Checks if a line start likely contains a function name based on character patterns.

methods.name: find_funcname_matching_regexp
methods.description: Searches through text starting at a point to find a line matching a function name pattern via regex.

methods.name: parse_range_funcname
methods.description: Parses a range specified by a function name pattern, locating matching function definitions in code.

methods.name: parse_range_arg
methods.description: Main function to parse a range argument string into begin and end line numbers, supporting various formats.

methods.name: skip_range_arg
methods.description: Skips over a range argument string, returning the position after the range specification.
